quotations.old_english: He ferde ge þurh mynsterstówe ge þurh folcstówe
quotations.latin: discurrĕre per urbāna et rustĭca lóca sŏlēbat

source_text: folc-stów, e; f. A public place, country place; publ&i-short;cus vel rust&i-short;cus l&o-short;cus :-- He ferde ge þurh mynsterstówe ge þurh folcstówe discurr&e-short;re per urb&a-long;na et rust&i-short;ca lóca s&o-short;l&e-long;bat, Bd. 3, 5; S. 526, 27.
